in_marathi.name: Bishakha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bishakha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bishakha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bishak’, which means ‘bringer of happiness’. In Hindu mythology, Bishakha is the name of a goddess, often depicted as a shakti or manifestation of the goddess Durga. She is said to bring happiness and prosperity to those who worship her.
